boundaries: The conflict token and transaction are device-local, not a distributed CAS. A newly inserted record outside the captured read set is not a conflict; this is not a serializable model judgment across the entire future memory collection.

New memory promotion/deduplication is outside this existing-record repair. No guarantee against repeated semantic extraction of a forgotten fact, and no physical event erasure or full pipeline quiescence API.
Memory snapshots and model input still read the existing whole active store for maintenance, with no completed pagination, model-budget policy or large-corpus campaign.

The runtime idle dirty counter still follows runtime-owned writes; external plugin/user/sync invalidation and time-only decay scheduling remain a separate gap. Conditional commit protects attempted plans, not whether every needed pass is scheduled.

Native model output was scripted, not autonomous inference. No packaged/Windows/Linux, true multi-device race, real model, upgrade-consent or complete lifecycle campaign was performed. Public observation, per-book grants and remaining capability families are still open.
